{{Quote|Cade! How&hellip;''"<br />"''Jedi hibernation trance. Old school. Good thing I didn't cut that class.|[[Deliah Blue]] and [[Cade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Legacy—War 6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref>}}
'''Hibernation trance''', '''healing trance''',<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> '''Jedi hibernation''', '''Force trance''', or '''recovery trance''' was an ability that allowed [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users to go into a very deep hibernation state.

==Description==
{{Quote|I assume the liquid metal left me when it could barely read my ''vital signs''?''"<br />"''Yes&mdash;''another'' use for Force trance, in addition to conserving air and vital functions!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Mask of Iron">{{TCWComicCite|6.44|Mask of Iron}}</ref>}}
Hibernation trance was a control-based [[Force power/Legends|ability]] that slowed the user's metabolism and breathing to a standstill, causing the individual to only use one tenth of the air of a normal individual. To all outward appearances, the individual appears to be dead; only thorough testing would determine that they were alive. Individuals using [[stethoscope]]s would be able to detect a faint heartbeat if they listened intently enough, and [[life sensor]]s would register a slight flicker. Other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]] with training in the [[Force power/Legends#Sense|Sense]] skill would be able to sense the hibernating individual in the Force and know they were not dead.<ref name="RPG" />

A fully trained Force-user could stay in this state for up to one [[Standard week/Legends|week]] in a dry climate or one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] in a wet climate before dying from lack of water. By hooking themselves up to an [[intravenous water drip]], they could extend the duration indefinitely. Individuals could hibernate for up to three months before dying of starvation; the application of an [[intravenous sugar-solution drip]] could extend the hibernation period to a [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="RPG" />

A hibernating Force-user would appear dead to all but another Force-user. This could lead to potentially dangerous results for the hibernating individual if nobody was aware of the truth. To avoid such situations, the person in a hibernation trance could provide a trigger phrase that, if recited by another person, would bring the Force-user out of the trance.<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

Trained force-users could also use a similar technique to place others in a hibernation trance. The target had to be a willing ally. The force-user touched the ally to place him into the trance. The ally would then benefit from the effects of the hibernation trance. The ally could not emerge from the trance on his own; he relied on the force-user to bring him out of it.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

There was another trance called [[Serenity (trance)|Serenity]], which was a brief meditative state that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] used to regain focus and power.<ref name="SECR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

==Users==
[[Kreia]] entered a hibernation trance to appear dead and be moved to the morgue at the [[Peragus Mining Facility]] in [[3951 BBY]].<ref name="KotOR II game">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

[[Bela Kiwiiks]] used a hibernation trance to survive torture from the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Praven]]&mdash;under orders from [[Darth Angral]]&mdash;when she was placed beside the active [[Shock Drum]].

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] used this ability on numerous occasions, such as during the [[Mission to Devaron]], in order to place himself outside of his former [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices's]] ([[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]) thoughts so they could fight clearly in times of great struggle.

It was also used, in combination with the natural [[Whiphid healing trance|healing trance]] of the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphids]], by the Whiphid [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[K'Kruhk]] to fake death after being struck down by [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] at the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of Hypori]].

In 378 BBY, the [[Kushiban]] Jedi Master [[Ikrit]] discovered the [[Golden Globe]] within the [[Palace of the Woolamander]], on the jungle moon of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Unable to break the curse and free the countless trapped [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] children, he used this ability to wait for someone who could. He was eventually discovered in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]] by [[Anakin Solo]] and [[Tahiri Veila]] whom he worked with to successfully break the curse. His hibernation lasted for 356 years, far beyond his species' natural lifespan and far beyond the usual biological limits on such a trance.

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was known to use it in the course of long hyperspace flights. His descendant, [[Cade Skywalker]], used it to survive the [[Massacre at Ossus|Massacre of Ossus]] and later, the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Coruscant]].
